messages.en:
Huh? What's going on?{01 00 00 14 00} This
seal is open! {01 01 00}{07 00 00}No way!{01 00 00 05 00} You
didn't open it, did you?
{07 15 00}I can tell if you're
lying, you know. {01 00 00 0a 00}You always
wiggle back and forth!
messages.et:
Mis? Mis toimub?{01 00 00 14 00} See
pitsat on lahti! {01 01 00}{07 00 00}Ei või olla!{01 00 00 05 00}
Sa ei avanud seda, ega?
{07 15 00}Ma näen, kui sa
valetad, tead. {01 00 00 0a 00}Sa liigutad
end alati edasi-tagasi!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}You read it! {01 01 00}I knew it! {01 00 00 0f 00}You
just can't trust someone
with opposable thumbs!
{07 01 00}Ugh!{01 00 00 14 00} If you do that again,
{01 00 00 05 00}I'll never {01 00 00 05 00}EVER forgive you!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Sa lugesid seda! {01 01 00}Ma
teadsin!{01 00 00 0f 00} Kedagi pöialdega ei
saa lihtsalt usaldada! {07 01 00}Öök!
{01 00 00 14 00} Kui sa seda uuesti teed,
{01 00 00 05 00}ei andesta ma sulle {01 00 00 05 00}KUNAGI!
